lesson: CI on PR 484 failed in the Postgres lane: apps/core/test/integration/permission-decision-memory.postgres.integration.test.ts beforeAll (createPostgresIntegrationRuntime, which runs the full migration set including the new snapshot) exceeded vitest's default 10 s hook timeout under CI load ("Hook timed out in 10000ms" at :26); the other 63 Postgres files passed because they declare a hook timeout. Do exactly this: add the sibling convention to that beforeAll — close it with }, 60_000); (see attachment-metadata.postgres.integration.test.ts for the same shape) — and nothing else: no afterAll change, no other file, no product code. Run prettier on the file; the Postgres leaves cannot run in the sandbox (EPERM 127.0.0.1:5432) — the host runs them.
